newsitem.title: USA: Kentucky Electric Steel sees Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Kentucky Electric Steel sees Q4 loss.

text.p: Kentucky Electric Steel Inc said Monday it could register a loss in the fourth quarter as competition forced it to lower its prices.

"The company continues to experience downward pricing pressures in several of its markets," it said. "We believe the higher costs combined with lower shipments and pricing will adversely affect fourth quarter earnings and may result in a loss for the quarter."
Kentucky said inefficiencies at its Melt Shop had reduced production, resulting in fewer shipments and greater costs per ton produced.

It said the inefficiencies were due to the starting up of its Ladle Metallurgy Facility in August. The facility, which removes the refining cycle from the electric arc furnace to increase melting capacity, is to come into full operation in the next few months, it said.
Although fiscal fourth quarter shipments are to be less than expected, they should improve during the comparable period in fiscal 1995, it added.
Kentucky operates a specialty steel mini-mill manufacturing special quality steel bar flats for a number of markets.
